title: Crash/restart durability — §28 database durability + §29 crash recovery
expected: crashes leave consistent durable state: no false executed records, no double claims, replay-safe orphaned claims, honest unknown outcomes
actual: Case A (pre-apply crash): no side effect, orphaned claim durable, retry refused; Case B (post-apply crash): side effect occurred but no success recorded, chain verifies, retry refused, fresh action id proceeds — reconciliation requires fresh read (documented)
observations: A: process killed after authorization claim, while the conditional PUT was in flight (pre-apply)
A: external truth: zero mutations (nothing happened)
A: audit after restart: action.validated, action.proposed; chain ok
A: blind retry after restart refused (ReplayDetectedError) — the operator reconciles with a NEW action id and fresh state
B: server applied the mutation and is HOLDING the response; client killed while awaiting it — the firewall can never record the outcome
B: external truth: the mutation WAS applied — but the firewall died before recording it
B: audit after restart: action.validated, action.proposed (no action.executed — the firewall never claims what it did not observe)
B: blind retry refused; fresh read reconciles the external world (revision advanced) before any new attempt
B: a fresh action id claims and executes normally — no stuck state, no double-claim corruption

block_classifications.detail: orphaned claim after crash is durable and replay-safe
crash after apply = unknown external outcome; persisted state is consistent and replay-safe; reconciliation requires a fresh read (documented)
